g.text: Sequence Diagram - WEB03 Role or Account-Status Change while the SPA is Open (back-end enforcement, non-recursive 401/403 handling)
The menu shown to the user was built when the roles were last confirmed (SD 1 / SD 2).
A change made in the meantime is enforced by the BACK END on the very next protected
request (AA03: resolveActor reloads the User every time), so no further protected
operation is accepted with the withdrawn permissions (AC 6).
Handling rule (3.4, BR 13): only BUSINESS requests reach handleAuthFailure();
401 is terminal (no /auth/me); 403 causes at most ONE /auth/me (single-flight);
/auth/me is sent with skipAuthFailureHandler = true, so its answer never re-enters the handler.
(or: deactivates the account / the token expires)
no new login is required for
submits "Adjust stock" (button visible: menu is stale)
[A) Token expired / invalid or user deleted]
401 { error: { message: "Invalid or expired token", status: 401 } }
[B) Account deactivated (or left with no role)]
403 { error: { message: "Account is not active", status: 403 } }
The SPA reacts BEFORE the error is returned to the page (business request -> handler invoked)
NO retry of the business request.
single-flight: if a refresh is in progress,
return the SAME promise (no new request)
the apiClient does NOT call handleAuthFailure()
for this answer; it only resolves / rejects.
was not permitted for this user
menu rebuilt (A', B', E': public only;
and planning groups removed; D': unchanged)
[decision is no longer ALLOW (A', B', C', E')]
unmount (stock data removed from the screen)
"You do not have permission to access this page.")
(only if still mounted, D') error feedback (WEB04):
"You do not have permission to perform this operation."
operation NOT shown as completed, input preserved
The same back-end checks (AuthMiddleware -> RoleMiddleware) apply when the request does not come
